scope: Live local multilingual model checks with short synthetic subtitle text; not an OpenSubtitles download or a complete episode.
limits: Short sample quality does not establish quality for all subtitle versions or languages.
The language model receives only dialogue and stable numeric IDs. Original timestamps and order are reconstructed outside the model.
Missing, duplicate or foreign output IDs fail the whole translation instead of publishing partial subtitles.
One multilingual generation job at a time; bounded batches and thirty-minute total deadline.
English continues to prefer the installed Argos EN-to-Portuguese model. Ollama is an opt-in fallback for other or unspecified source languages.
Stopping browser polling does not claim to cancel an already running local backend job.

openSubtitlesLiveDiscovery.scope: Actual OpenSubtitles search through local HPmovies API. These discovery counts do not establish full subtitle translation or synchronization.
